title: Applicationprocess delivers-value Applicationservice
description: The multi-step workflow or orchestration supplies the behaviour that makes the externally offered application service worth consuming, so the service's outcome is produced by running the process to completion.
x-dr-evidence: The service's public operation (e.g. an API handler or service-interface method) delegates its work to the workflow, saga or pipeline entry point and returns that process's end result to the caller.
